name: allterrain-fields
description: Custom fields for WordPress with every premium feature free, as an OpenStation desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundles && npm run deploy
scripts.build:builder: ATCF_TARGET=builder vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=builder vite build --mode production
scripts.build:bulk: ATCF_TARGET=bulk vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=bulk vite build --mode production
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:fields && npm run build:builder && npm run build:model && npm run build:tools && npm run build:bulk && npm run build:widget && npm run build:dock
scripts.build:dock: ATCF_TARGET=dock vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=dock vite build --mode production
scripts.build:fields: ATCF_TARGET=fields vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=fields vite build --mode production
scripts.build:model: ATCF_TARGET=model vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=model vite build --mode production
scripts.build:tools: ATCF_TARGET=tools vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=tools vite build --mode production
scripts.build:widget: ATCF_TARGET=widget vite build --mode development && ATCF_TARGET=widget vite build --mode production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:bundles
scripts.plugin:build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:bundles
